title: Tencent Yuanbao Search Launches Standalone Web Version, Extending Enterprise Capabilities to Consumers
excerpt: Tencent Yuanbao Search has recently officially launched a standalone web version for individual users (so.qq.com), bringing its search capabilities—previously m
content_html:
Tencent Yuanbao Search has recently officially launched a standalone web version for individual users (so.qq.com), bringing its search capabilities—previously made available externally through Tencent Cloud—to the consumer market as a standalone product.

This entry defaults to AI mode. After users enter a question, an AI answer is generated on the left while reference materials are displayed simultaneously on the right; pressing Enter switches to traditional feed-style keyword search. No search ads are currently visible on the page.

In terms of functionality, the PC version of Yuanbao Search supports separate searches of WeChat Official Account and WeChat Channels content. These two types of closed sources within the WeChat ecosystem form its differentiated capability compared with general-purpose search engines. It also provides vertical entries such as academic and popular science, organizations, mainstream media, and images and videos.
